summary: Adversarial verification of wf/design/permissions.{md,json} (328 rows). Evidence quality is high: every quoted fragment on the 157 quoted CONFIRMED rows was located on the cited board, handoff JSON or stakeholder record (351/504 fragments matched verbatim automatically; the rest resolved manually as composite captions or stakeholder-record quotes), and the 24 unquoted CONFIRMED rows were spot-checked against boards and surface action lists. No row grants ACC/SACC as a side effect of Publish/Release and no row sets Completed from a launch (five-state check passes). Every data-changing action in surface-*.json screens[].actions has a row. The deliverable fails its own CONFIRMED definition ('no open T-/OD- item governing that exact point') on 12 rows that must be downgraded (REQ-02, REQ-12, REQ-16, CC-07, EXP-06, EXP-07, EXP-08, UPD-12, UPD-22, UPD-23, ROLE-13, DTR-03). Another 9 rows must be split (REQ-25, REQ-26, UPD-20, ROLE-04, SES-04, ATT-20, XC-02, SEL-02, ATT-08), and 8 CONFIRMED rows have scope columns that contradict PROVISIONAL sibling rows. Three stakeholder-basis claims are unsupported: BR-113 lists no stakeholder source; STK31-40/42 do not forbid a Reports destination; and 07.2-C covers forwarding while paused, not creating a request. 14 rows describe actions no board draws but carry kind ALLOW. One of them, SUB-35, is a removed prototype behaviour, so the claim in §1.1 that no ALLOW row brings back a removed behaviour is false. Three stakeholder conflicts are not flagged: ATT-16 vs D-25 in STK31-32, PER-16 vs STK31-25 and 07.3 R06, and RUN-14 vs STK31-42. CC-05's safe treatment contradicts CC-04. The claim that all 278 permissionEvidence entries were used is off by 16. 152 of 181 CONFIRMED rows survive unchanged.

checksRun.detail: Extracted visible text + script strings of all 128 boards (wf/verify/_perm/btxt) and machine-matched every quoted fragment in every row's evidence (504 fragments): 351 verbatim in the cited board/JSON, 96 verbatim on another board/JSON (segments the parser could not attribute), 57 not verbatim. All 57 resolved manually: composite captions (e.g. B1-11 'What happens after you decide — four separate events 1 Institution record …', B7-03 'Status handling allowed Pause (active or ending soon) · Restore (paused)', B6-07 'Publish It appears in the public catalogue. It gives no one access.', B6-03 'Approve Sends it to the Content Manager. Approving does not publish.', 06-Sidebar-Variants 'Account menu · same pattern in every workspace') and stakeholder-record quotes (STK31-31 'FACULTY is the ONLY human role…', STK31-32 'D-25 — a learner never sees the answer key — is NOT overridden', STK31-08 'Vendor does NOT own Learning Outcomes', STK31-41 'Do NOT assume assignment is global-only', STK31-33 'REVIEW REQUIRED'). Result: all 157 quoted CONFIRMED rows have locatable evidence; 24 unquoted CONFIRMED rows (REQ-17, REQ-26, INST-03, INST-08, SACC-09, SACC-19, GRP-01, PER-06, PER-11, PER-14, CC-01, CC-02, RUN-09, CMP-04, Q-01, ATT-19, DTR-13, DTR-14, UPD-20, CRS-03, CRS-07, ROLE-03, ROLE-04, XC-02) spot-checked against boards (e.g. B7-03 'The Institute Admin manages people; a status change here is an override with a reason.'; B4-10 'Not shown Format feedback (T-25), any score before marking.'; B2-04 script canWithdraw: !s.paused && r.via === 'ind' && (r.st === 'active' || r.st === 'waiting'); B7-03 script noIA includes 'paused') — supported. The failures are classification, not evidence: see corrections 1–6 and 13–18.

checksRun.check: (a) CONFIRMED rows citing open decision ids
checksRun.detail: 54 CONFIRMED rows carry T-/OD-/REG-/ND- ids. The md says such ids 'do not change the permission itself'. For 17 rows the cited open item governs the exact point stated in the row: REQ-02/REQ-12 (T-04 'Super Admin sets it at approval; visitors never self-classify' — DESIGN NOW SAFELY), REQ-16/REQ-25/REQ-26 (T-07, OD-B3-09; boards annotate 'mirrors the current plan — T-07', '(T-07 open)', 'smaller scope unavailable (T-07, D8)'), CC-07 (REG-SA-COURSE-CODE 'WAIT FOR DECISION'), EXP-06 (REG-D-09-6 'WAIT (any bypass)'), EXP-07 (REG-07.2-F), EXP-08/UPD-12 (REG-VE-10-14 'WAIT FOR DECISION'), UPD-20/22/23 (OD-B7-01/02/03), ROLE-04 (OD-B7-10), ROLE-13/SES-04 (REG-XS-02 'WAIT FOR DECISION'), ATT-08 (OD-B4-06; B4-09 'Feedback optional (open — see B4-16)'). The remaining 37 are legitimate: the open item governs a detail and not the permission (e.g. CMP-01/T-12, SACC-07/D7, Q-01/T-21).

Stakeholder records were read read-only (ui-ux/00-project-context/STAKEHOLDER_CONFIRMED_UPDATE_2026-08-31.md; ui-ux/18-unified-functional-platform/stakeholder-review/STAKEHOLDER_CORRECTIONS_07_2.md, STAKEHOLDER_CLOSURE_07_3.md; PM_CONFIRMED_BASELINE_2026-08-18.md). Unsupported: UPD-22/UPD-23 and UPD-20's reason requirement (BR-113 is labelled CONFIRMED-STAKEHOLDER, but its sources are boards plus OD-B7-01/02/03 only; STK31-07 only assigns Release/Hold to the Super Admin). REQ-16: 07.2-D says only 'same payment method', and the reviewed prototype let renewals inherit 'the grant-may-only-narrow rule'. ATT-20/XC-02 'no Reports destination': STK31-40/42 forbid only fake financial analytics and revenue metrics, and PM-11 says detailed reports are 'pending'. DTR-03: 07.2-C 'Two honest edges' covers forwarding, not the Student creating a request. SEL-02 'never cart/basket': STK31-18 itself says 'ecommerce-style selection / cart experience'. Supported: STK31-06/07/08/18/19/20/21/22/24/25/31/32/33/34/39/41, 07.2-C/E/F and 07.3 R08/R15/R16/R17/R18 as cited elsewhere.

The 15 INFERRED rows are all DENY absences (never-build), which is consistent with P4. But 14 rows describe actions no board draws ('not drawn' / 'not designed' / 'not stated') and still carry kind ALLOW: REQ-19, REQ-22, INST-06, SACC-08, PER-07, PER-08, CC-06, Q-11, ATT-17, DTR-09, SUB-35, ROLE-11, SUP-04, SES-09. This contradicts the md's own definition ('ALLOW = the design offers the action to the role'). ASMT-13 grants 'share and edit', but B4-05 says only 'Co-teaching Faculty on the same course see the same assessment (none in this sample)'. No invented scopes beyond the inconsistencies in check (f).

All data-changing actions from the seven surface-*.json screens[].actions lists (373 candidate lines filtered from 804) map to a row. Examples: PU-06/07 → SEL-01; PU-08 → REQ-01; ST-08 → RUN-03/04; ST-13 → ATT-02/03; ST-16 → FB-02; ST-18 → DTR-01; FA-07/09/10 → ASMT-01/02/04/05/06; FA-14…17 → Q-01…07; FA-19 → ATT-08/09; IA-04/05 → SACC-01/02/07; IA-07 → PER-05/06; IA-10/11 → PER-01/02/03; IA-13/14 → GRP-01…04; IA-15 → FCM-01/02; IA-16 → CC-01; IA-17 → REQ-25/26; IA-19 → DTR-06; VE-03…09 → SUB-01…09; RV-03/04 → LO-01, SUB-17/18, UPD-13/14; CM-03/08/09 → SUB-24/26/27, UPD-01/04/05/08, CC-04; SA-03/07/11/13/14/15/16/17/19/21 → REQ-12…17, INST-04/07/08, PER-11, UPD-19/20/22, SUB-33, CRS-01…04, ROLE-01…04, DTR-10, SUP-05/06. Missing READ/DENY rows are listed in correction 20.

None of the removed behaviours in functional-prototype.json appears as a CONFIRMED or PROVISIONAL ALLOW. Decline is denied on DTR-11 (device) and REQ-20 (requests); Student self-completion on CMP-02; Vendor update proposals on EXP-08/UPD-12; CM/SA live edits on EXP-06/EXP-07; SA writing the platform code on CC-07; AI-suggested marks on ATT-11; applicant replies on REQ-06; reason-less withdrawal and deactivation on SACC-07/PER-05; Faculty mapping at experiment level on FCM-06. However: SUB-35 'Override to other targets' has kind ALLOW. That is the removed 'Override to arbitrary non-published statuses (state.js:8817-8896)', and §1.1 even cites SUB-35 as its guard. SUP-04 (reporter reopen) is also ALLOW. The §1.1 sentence 'None of the ALLOW rows re-introduces a removed behaviour' is therefore false. Half marks are mapped to ATT-11/Q-08/ASMT-11, none of which mentions them. The whole-number rule is in ATT-08 (B4-09 'Out of 10, as a whole number').

No row writes ACC or SACC as a side effect of Publish or Release: SACC-18 and SUB-30 are DENY, SUB-24 and UPD-19 say 'gives no one access', and REQ-14/ACC-01 activation comes from request approval (BR-036), not from publication. No row sets Completed from a launch, a resource or an assessment: CMP-01 is the only route (SYSTEM), CMP-02/03/04 are DENY, and RUN-03 says 'never sets Completed'. 'Waiting for a licence' is seeded and never computed (ACC-09). Minor: RUN-03 still attributes the In progress write to the Student's launch (correction 25).

FCM ∩ ACC (FCM-04, SACC-20, EXP-04) is supported by B4-02 'Scope Only courses the Institute Admin assigned (B2-09) … only experiments the institution holds (ACC-0107)'. IA own-institution and active-plan-only (SACC-04, STK31-24) are supported. Reviewer scope on CONFIRMED SUB-17/SUB-18/UPD-13/UPD-14 conflicts with PROVISIONAL SUB-23 (OD-B6-01; B6-01 'How reviewers are given courses is open (Register RV-F2 · "Reviewer course scoping")'). CM scope on SUB-24/UPD-01 conflicts with PROVISIONAL ROLE-10/EXP-10. Vendor assigned-course scope on CONFIRMED SUB-01/SUB-03 conflicts with PROVISIONAL CRS-08 (T-29) and SUB-11 (OD-B5-01).

checksRun.detail: The 16 flagged rows are correct. Not flagged: ATT-16 (STK31-32 'D-25 — a learner never sees the answer key — is NOT overridden' vs B4-13 ST-14 correct answers after release); PER-16 (STK31-25 Tenant Admin 'reporting and visibility over assigned students and content' and 07.3 R06 'he should have that overview' vs a basis-INFERRED never-build deny); RUN-14 (STK31-42 'students/users by stream where available' is named in the §4.4 prose but the row flag is null); EXP-07 cites STK31-09 but omits STK31-08 ('Super Admin | Canonical/master metadata management (also permitted)'). Four rows are marked CONFIRMED despite a stakeholder conflict whose register item is still open (CC-07, EXP-06, EXP-07; UPD-12/EXP-08 via REG-VE-10-14).

CC-05's treatment 'Do not build a control' contradicts CC-04 (CONFIRMED: the CM saves codes for every course on B6-10, including ME ZG523, which has published experiments) and the OD-B6-13 safe treatment 'Saved directly by the Content Manager (M-2)'. GRP-05's 'Do not build a control' contradicts GRP-04, where Remove member is built.

Counts in json and md agree: 328 rows; 181/106/41; 115/149/53/11; 16 conflict rows; 13 handoff defects; 31 no-rule PROVISIONAL rows. The claim that all 278 permissionEvidence entries are cited is false: 16 are not cited (public-entry #11, #12, #22, #29; student #39; faculty #33, #39; institute-admin #4, #20, #28, #33, #39; reviewer-cm #29; super-admin #24, #51, #59). Their content is covered by other rows.
